content.introduction: According to Morningstar, Bending Spoons SpA, Chaince Digital Holdings Inc, Penguin Solutions Inc, Braze Inc, and NorthWestern Energy Group Inc were among the top gainers. Penguin Solutions Inc reported Q4 2026 revenue of $567 million, up 68% year-over-year, and raised its fiscal 2027 outlook. Tradingeconomics reported that the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq 100 dropped 0.3% from their peaks, while the Dow fell 0.6%. Business Insider highlighted that stocks had their best month since 2020, but cautioned about the fragility of the US economy. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on specific company earnings or detailed market trends beyond what is mentioned.
